zero_slop_policy.statement: NO AI SLOP ALLOWED AT ALL - ZERO TOLERANCE TO SLOP AND HALLUCINATIONS

tpm_judge.persona_contract: Legendary TPM judge accountable for reopening the closed run with a new bead before applying the user-requested UI standard change.
tpm_judge.rationale: TB-20260426-107 and STEP-NORTHSTAR-007 were added after the closed run rather than silently mutating the previous QA bead.

material_standards_juror.persona_contract: Material systems juror accountable for rejecting vague Material claims without tokenized color, shape, typography, motion, and state behavior.
material_standards_juror.rationale: CSS includes Material system tokens and the static audit now enforces key tokens and motion.

ux_juror.persona_contract: Product UX juror accountable for daily-workflow speed, scanability, mobile ergonomics, and non-regressive app usefulness.
ux_juror.rationale: Browser desktop and mobile WYSIWYG checks passed after the Material UI update.

verification_juror.persona_contract: Verification juror accountable for executable proof across core behavior, static UI checks, accessibility, and browser WYSIWYG flows.
verification_juror.rationale: Core, static UI, accessibility, and browser WYSIWYG tests passed.

hawkeye_auditor.persona_contract: Independent conformance auditor accountable for rejecting skipped ledger, trace, gate, or certificate updates.
hawkeye_auditor.rationale: Material UI bead, gate, panel, certificate, KG, TPM, PERT, TASKS, and validation updates are present.

adversarial_prosecutor.persona_contract: Adversarial prosecutor accountable for attacking fake Google conformance, inaccessible colors, and overclaimed certification.
adversarial_prosecutor.rationale: The claim is bounded to internal DFMS conformance; tests verify token presence, contrast, keyboard, state, and screenshots.

jury_foreperson.persona_contract: Foreperson accountable for final verdict, dissent, residual risks, and legal next action.
jury_foreperson.rationale: No open P0/P1 Material UI standards finding remains for this bounded demonstrator.

verdict.next_action: RUN-CLOSED unless a new change request is opened
